result.title: Compared to What? Calibrating Machine-Unlearning Diagnostics with Present, Absent and Suppressed Anchors
result.summary: Unlearning methods for language models are judged mainly by behaviour, but a model can stop producing an answer while still encoding it. Internal diagnostics such as linear probes, the logit lens and relearning speed are used to tell removal from suppression, yet none has been checked against cases where the answer is known. We build such cases. A present anchor learned a set of synthetic facts; an absent anchor is a never-taught oracle retrained without them; and suppressed anchors are unlearned with their lower layers frozen, so the facts stay encoded below the frozen block by construction. We compare these anchors with NPO, RMU and gradient difference at a matched operating point on GPT-2 Small and Qwen3-0.6B-Base, scoring every diagnostic per entity with AUROC against the oracle. Behaviour cannot separate the suppressed anchors from the oracle (AUROC 0.51 to 0.58), while probes, the logit lens and relearning gain can (0.65 to 1.00), and the oracle seeds stay near 0.5. Applied to NPO on both models and RMU on Qwen3, the validated diagnostics disagree: probes put the facts at the oracle's level, while the models still relearn them much faster than a never-taught model does. Every unlearned model, anchor or method, also assigns the forgotten answer a far lower log-probability than the oracle does, a black-box signal that flagged all of them. A drift-ratio specificity rule fails on known cases. Code, data and every run are at https://github.com/ArsalanKaleem/unlearning-audit.

AI.brief_summary: 该文构建「存在／从未习得／被抑制」三类锚点（被抑制锚点通过冻结底层使事实按构造仍被编码），在 GPT-2 Small 与 Qwen3-0.6B-Base 上以 AUROC 对标 oracle，检验线性探针、logit lens、重学习速度等内部诊断能否区分「真正移除」与「仅行为抑制」，并发现不同方法下这些诊断结论相互冲突。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「用探针与 logit lens 判断内部状态是否仍编码信息、并与行为指标对照」的思路，可能可供核查 LVR 中 latent 状态是否保留视觉细节、答案是否真正使用 latent 内容而非旁路，但纯文本设定需改造，且未涉及多模态。
